description: Enrichment test for ROF1-repressed targets, motif-length specificity curve, FLO11 extended promoter scan
code:
import pandas as pd, numpy as np, re, requests, os, matplotlib.pyplot as plt
from scipy import stats
H={"User-Agent":"openscientist/1.0"}
print("cwd",os.getcwd(), os.listdir("."))

fa=pd.read_csv("https://ftp.ensembl.org/pub/current_fasta/saccharomyces_cerevisiae/dna/Saccharomyces_cerevisiae.R64-1-1.dna.toplevel.fa.gz",
               sep="\x01",header=None,compression="gzip",names=["l"],dtype=str,quoting=3).l.tolist()
genome={}; cur=None; buf=[]
for line in fa:
    if line.startswith(">"):
        if cur: genome[cur]="".join(buf)
        cur=line[1:].split()[0]; buf=[]
    else: buf.append(line.strip().upper())
genome[cur]="".join(buf)
CH=[c for c in genome if c!="Mito"]
gtf=pd.read_csv("https://ftp.ensembl.org/pub/release-115/gtf/saccharomyces_cerevisiae/Saccharomyces_cerevisiae.R64-1-1.115.gtf.gz",
                sep="\t",comment="#",header=None,compression="gzip",
                names=["chrom","src","feat","start","end","score","strand","frame","attr"],dtype={"chrom":str})
g=gtf[gtf.feat=="gene"].copy()
g["gene_id"]=g.attr.str.extract(r'gene_id "([^"]+)"'); g["gene_name"]=g.attr.str.extract(r'gene_name "([^"]+)"')
g["biotype"]=g.attr.str.extract(r'gene_biotype "([^"]+)"'); g["name"]=g.gene_name.fillna(g.gene_id)
g=g[(g.biotype=="protein_coding")&(g.chrom.isin(CH))].reset_index(drop=True)
def revcomp(s): return s.translate(str.maketrans("ACGTN","TGCAN"))[::-1]
def prom(r,UP):
    c=genome[r.chrom]
    return c[max(0,r.start-1-UP):r.start-1] if r.strand=="+" else revcomp(c[r.end:min(len(c),r.end+UP)])
IUP={"A":"A","C":"C","G":"G","T":"T","W":"[AT]","N":"[ACGT]","R":"[AG]","Y":"[CT]"}
def rx(m): return "".join(IUP[c] for c in m)
def rcm(m):
    cm={"A":"T","T":"A","G":"C","C":"G","W":"W","N":"N","R":"Y","Y":"R"}
    return "".join(cm[c] for c in reversed(m))
def cnt_both(s,m): return len(re.findall("(?=%s)"%rx(m),s))+len(re.findall("(?=%s)"%rx(rcm(m)),s))

UP=700
P=pd.DataFrame([dict(gene_id=r.gene_id,name=r.name,seq=prom(r,UP)) for r in g.itertuples()])
P["GTTTA"]=P.seq.map(lambda s:cnt_both(s,"GTTTA"))
P["ANGTTTA"]=P.seq.map(lambda s:cnt_both(s,"ANGTTTA"))
P["AAGTTTAA"]=P.seq.map(lambda s:cnt_both(s,"AAGTTTAA"))
P["AAAAGTTTAACTT"]=P.seq.map(lambda s:cnt_both(s,"AAAAGTTTAACTT"))
TG={"FLO11":"YIR019C","FLO10":"YKR102W","TEC1":"YBR083W"}

# (a) are the three repressed targets enriched vs all promoters?
print("\n--- enrichment test of the 3 ROF1-repressed genes vs genome background (GTTTA, 700 bp) ---")
bg=P.GTTTA.values; tg=np.array([P.loc[P.gene_id==v,"GTTTA"].iloc[0] for v in TG.values()])
print("target counts",dict(zip(TG,tg)),"| background mean %.2f sd %.2f"%(bg.mean(),bg.std()))
u,pu=stats.mannwhitneyu(tg,bg,alternative="greater")
print("Mann-Whitney U (targets > background): U=%.1f p=%.3f"%(u,pu))
rng=np.random.default_rng(0)
perm=np.array([rng.choice(bg,3,replace=False).mean() for _ in range(20000)])
print("permutation p (mean of 3 >= observed %.2f): %.3f"%(tg.mean(),(perm>=tg.mean()).mean()))

# (b) specificity ceiling: motif length vs number of promoters hit
print("\n--- how long must the site be to be selective? (extending the crystal site) ---")
site="AAAAGTTTAACTT"; rows=[]
for L in range(4,14):
    st=(13-L)//2; m=site[st:st+L]
    nprom=(P.seq.map(lambda s:cnt_both(s,m))>0).sum(); tot_hits=P.seq.map(lambda s:cnt_both(s,m)).sum()
    rows.append(dict(length=L,subsite=m,promoters_with_site=int(nprom),pct=round(100*nprom/len(P),1),total_sites=int(tot_hits)))
S=pd.DataFrame(rows); print(S.to_string(index=False))

# (c) FLO11 extended 3 kb promoter
flo11=g[g.gene_id=="YIR019C"].iloc[0]
for w in [700,1000,2000,3000]:
    s=prom(flo11,w)
    print(f"FLO11 {w} bp upstream: GTTTA={cnt_both(s,'GTTTA')}  ANGTTTA={cnt_both(s,'ANGTTTA')}  AAGTTTAA={cnt_both(s,'AAGTTTAA')}  13mer={cnt_both(s,site)}")

# artifacts
P.drop(columns=["seq"]).to_csv("promoter_WOPR_motif_counts.csv",index=False)
S.to_csv("motif_length_vs_specificity.csv",index=False)

fig,ax=plt.subplots(figsize=(7,4.5))
ax.plot(S.length,S.promoters_with_site,"o-",color="#34495e")
ax.set_yscale("log"); ax.axhline(len(P),ls=":",color="grey")
ax.text(4.1,len(P)*1.05,"all 6572 promoters",fontsize=8,color="grey")
for _,r in S.iterrows(): ax.annotate(r.subsite,(r.length,max(r.promoters_with_site,0.6)),fontsize=7,rotation=35,ha="left",va="bottom")
ax.set_xlabel("length of contiguous site taken from the 4QTJ crystal duplex (bp)")
ax.set_ylabel("promoters with >=1 match (700 bp windows, log scale)")
ax.set_title("Only sites longer than the WOPR footprint become selective")
plt.tight_layout(); plt.show()
print("\nartifacts written:",[f for f in os.listdir(".") if f.endswith(".csv")])
